gloss: to fantasize; to have delusions; to imagine wildly
notes:
Has two distinct registers of use. In casual conversation and internet culture, it means wild fantasizing or daydreaming (often with a self-deprecating or humorous tone). In medical and psychiatric contexts, it refers to clinical delusions — fixed false beliefs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧: to be lost in fantasies
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}{妄想|もうそう}→被害妄想：18124_higaimousou⟧: persecution complex, paranoid delusions
- ⟦{誇大|こだい}→誇大：28046_kodai⟧⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧: delusions of grandeur
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧{癖|ぐせ}: habit of fantasizing
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧{力|りょく}: power of imagination (humorous)

REGISTER:
In casual and internet usage, ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧ is often used playfully to describe harmless daydreaming, especially about fictional characters or unlikely scenarios. In formal and medical contexts, it describes pathological delusions.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧: fantasy, daydream — more neutral and literary; lacks the negative or clinical connotation
- ⟦{幻覚|げんかく}→幻覚：17636_genkaku⟧: hallucination — perceiving things that aren't there (sensory), whereas ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧ is about beliefs
- ⟦{想像|そうぞう}→想像：02489_souzou⟧: imagination — neutral and general; the standard word for imagining things

definitions.gloss: to indulge in unrealistic fantasies or daydreams
definitions.explanation: to indulge in unrealistic fantasies or daydreams; to imagine scenarios that are unlikely or impossible
to have delusions; to suffer from false beliefs detached from reality, especially in a clinical or psychiatric sense
